---
title: "Deadlines"
---

::: {.callout-warning}
All dates are **tentative** until the August 2026 academic calendar is finalized. Confirmed dates are posted on Slack.
:::

Three assignments and three quizzes (best two count). Each assignment deadline is followed by a short individual viva.

| Week | Event |
|:---:|---|
| 1 | Course begins |
| 3 | Assignment 1 released |
| 5 | **Assignment 1 due** → individual viva |
| 6 | **Quiz 1** |
| 7 | Assignment 2 released |
| 9 | **Assignment 2 due** → individual viva |
| 10 | **Quiz 2** (mid-semester) |
| 11 | Assignment 3 released |
| 13 | **Assignment 3 due** → individual viva |
| 15 | **Quiz 3** (end-semester) |

See [Grading](grading.qmd) for how these count.
